results.description:
Bausy is the all-in-one pet care app built for dog owners, cat lovers and anyone caring for rabbits, ferrets or other companions. Replace scattered notes and paper folders with a single pet health tracker — vaccinations, medications, vet records, smart reminders, AI guidance and local service booking, all in one beautiful app.

Whether you are a first-time pet parent or managing a busy household with multiple animals, Bausy helps you stay organized, proactive and confident about your pet's wellbeing.

PET HEALTH PROFILE & VETERINARY RECORDS
• Complete digital health card per pet — breed, age, photo and profile details
• Vaccination tracker and vaccine reminder with next-dose dates and overdue alerts
• Medication manager with dosage, schedule and linked intake reminders
• Allergy tracker and chronic disease records for safer vet visits
• Weight tracker with history, averages, trends and visual charts
• Upload and store vet documents, lab results, prescriptions and medical files
• EU pet passport, microchip number and identification details in one place
• Customizable health card — show the sections that matter to you
• Emergency QR code to share vital pet info with vets, sitters or finders instantly

SMART REMINDERS & PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
• Pet reminder app for vaccines, pills, flea treatments, grooming and vet appointments
• One-time and repeating reminders — general tasks, appointments and medication doses
• Push notifications delivered to your phone before important due dates
• Home dashboard highlights overdue tasks, today's to-dos and what's coming next
• Full pet activity log — see who changed what and when across all profiles

AI PET ASSISTANT — SHARO
• Personal AI assistant trained for pet care and aware of your pet's profile
• Ask about symptoms, nutrition, training, behaviour, breed traits and daily routines
• Urgent case guidance — calm, practical advice when something seems wrong
• Curated prompts for emergencies, care tips, breed questions and obedience training
• Daily pet care tips tailored to breed, age and season (Bausy+)

WATCHDOG — PROACTIVE HEALTH ALERTS FOR YOUR PET
• Smart alerts for upcoming vaccinations, ending medications and scheduled appointments
• Weather-aware walk tips — heat, cold, rain, strong wind, hail and storms
• Weight change notices, senior screening reminders and seasonal parasite alerts
• Post-vaccination care guidance and allergy awareness notifications
• Critical health alerts are always free — no subscription required

FAMILY PET SHARING & COLLABORATION
• Share pets with your partner, family members or pet sitter
• Granular access — choose who can view or edit each animal's profile
• Create a family group with invite codes or QR scan to join
• Perfect when several people share daily care responsibilities

MORE FEATURES PET OWNERS LOVE
• Educational pet care articles and tips inside the app
• Multi-language support — use Bausy in your preferred language
• Light, dark and system theme for comfortable day and night use
• Clean, modern design inspired by the best mobile apps
• Free plan for core pet tracking; Bausy+ unlocks unlimited pets, documents, family sharing, smart insights, Watchdog extras and unlimited AI chat

Download Bausy today — the pet health diary, vet record keeper, medication reminder, vaccination tracker and grooming booking app your companion deserves. Everything for your pet's care, finally in one place.
